### Day 44: 2 Samuel 5:1–5
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-44-2-samuel-5-15.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:2
Points:
- David's coronation marks the exciting fulfillment of God's longstanding promise.
- God chose an unlikely shepherd boy rather than what human wisdom expected.
- David's years of waiting and hardship prepared him for national leadership.
- The integrity and protective care David showed toward literal sheep equipped him to shepherd God's people.

### Israel Anoints David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israel-anoints-david
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:3
Points:
- Israel's elders recognized David based on kinship, military faithfulness, and God's sovereign appointment.
- Spiritual leaders cannot simply self-appoint; they must be affirmed and received by God's people.
- David's establishment in Jerusalem fulfilled ancient covenant promises given centuries earlier to Abraham.
- Believers must remain patient and persistent in faith because God always fulfills His promises in His timing.
